Error spending functions

Source: R/gs_spend.R
gs_spend.Rd

Cumulative error spent at information fractions t for a total (one-sided) error alpha.

Usage

gs_spend(
  t,
  alpha = 0.025,
  type = c("OF", "Pocock", "HSD", "power", "user"),
  param = NULL
)

Arguments

t

Information fractions between 0 and 1.

alpha

Total error to spend.

type

Type of spending function: "OF", "Pocock", "HSD", "power" or "user".

param

Parameter of the spending function (required for "HSD", "power" and "user").

Value

Numeric vector of cumulative error spent.

Details

The available types are

  • "OF": Lan-DeMets spending function of O'Brien-Fleming type, 2 - 2 pnorm(qnorm(1 - alpha / 2) / sqrt(t)).

  • "Pocock": Lan-DeMets spending function of Pocock type, alpha log(1 + (exp(1) - 1) t).

  • "HSD": Hwang-Shih-DeCani family with parameter param (gamma), alpha (1 - exp(-gamma t)) / (1 - exp(-gamma)), and alpha t for gamma = 0.

  • "power": Kim-DeMets power family with parameter param (rho), alpha t^rho.

  • "user": cumulative proportions of alpha given in param, one value per element of t.

The same functions are used for beta spending, with alpha replaced by the total type II error.

References

Lan KKG, DeMets DL (1983). Discrete sequential boundaries for clinical trials. Biometrika 70:659-663.

See also

gs_bounds

Examples

gs_spend(c(0.5, 0.75, 1), alpha = 0.025, type = "OF")
#> [1] 0.001525323 0.009649325 0.025000000
gs_spend(c(0.5, 0.75, 1), alpha = 0.1, type = "HSD", param = -2)
#> [1] 0.02689414 0.05449458 0.10000000
